tool_args.rationale: Fit the four parameters of the verified transformed Hill-2 inhibition and linear-bleed law numerically. The supplied tau scale is 1.0, and the varied pilot inputs and sink gradients support fitting without an additional probe. Fresh confirmation will assess the model against the stated tolerance.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed sink-gradient span is 2.0, well above the specified 0.08 threshold; the pilot already varies both input and inhibition.
These alternatives omit the strong sink-gradient dependence indicated by the pilot and the verified Hill mechanism.
The verified readout is a present snapshot, so a trajectory batch is not needed to identify temporal dynamics.
